script_text: Pisces, the veil between dreams and reality tears wide open this week as Neptune stirs your deepest waters. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury in your 10th House squares Neptune in your 1st, clouding career moves; Tuesday is worst for signing new contracts. Wednesday, Venus trines ruling Neptune in your 7th House, best for love. Thursday is the turning point: the Sun opposes Neptune across your 7th/1st House axis, forcing partnership boundaries and personal honesty. Friday through Sunday, Mars enters your 5th House of creativity, shifting energy to passion. The weekend favors art and spontaneous romance over errands. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines Neptune in your 7th House of love and intimacy. Tuesday is your danger day because Mercury squares Neptune in your 10th House. Keep a dream journal and trust your water element intuition before making financial moves. Follow for daily updates.
